label: TypeScript and JavaScript e2e tests (Playwright Test)
description: End-to-end tests of TypeScript and JavaScript components with the project's Playwright Test against its compose services (jgates.yml services:), Chromium from the toolchain volume. Comes in by evidence: a playwright.config.* or @playwright/test in package.json; runs only where e2e is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Without a services section it is SERVICES_REQUIRED, never a blocker.
